title: YESciEval: Robust LLM-as-a-Judge for Scientific Question Answering
paper_type_zh: 科学问答 LLM-as-a-judge 评测、对抗审计与对齐论文
best_for_zh: 需要审计科学问答 judge 或构建 rubric 条件化评测集的研究者。
one_line: A rubric-based evaluation framework for scientific question answering that audits judge robustness under adversarial data.
以 9 项 rubric、对抗变体和开源 judge 审计科学问答回答的可靠性。
why: It provides an auditable judgment-required feedback surface for post-training reasoning data and evaluation.
inclusion_reason: Track 07 addition: the central contribution creates, calibrates, or audits rubric-, expert-, or LLM-judgment data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Scientific search systems produce free-form answers from papers, but n-gram metrics miss factual, structural, and stylistic failures while expert review is costly. Generic LLM judges can also score flawed answers too generously, so their feedback is unsafe as an evaluation or reward signal.

YESciEval addresses this with a rubric-based, open-model evaluation framework for science Q&A. It supplies benign and deliberately degraded answer variants, enabling a judge to be tested on whether it lowers its score for a defined quality failure.

科学检索系统会根据论文生成自由文本答案，但 n-gram 指标难以识别事实、结构和文体错误，专家评审又难以扩展。通用 LLM judge 还可能对有缺陷的回答给出过高分，因此其反馈不能直接作为可靠的评测或奖励信号。

YESciEval 以基于 rubric 的开源模型评测框架处理这一问题。它提供正常答案及被刻意降质的变体，用于检验 judge 是否会针对已定义的质量缺陷降低评分。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: YESciEval turns science-answer judgment into nine explicit rubric scores and rationales, then trains an open LLaMA-3.1-8B judge with SFT followed by contrastive preference optimization on benign-versus-adversarial examples. Its released corpus covers ORKGSyn and BioASQ answer records, including 33 disciplines and biomedical Q&A, with 1--5 rubric scores from multiple LLMs. The data are released as CSV under CC BY 4.0 through the YESciEval Corpus repository; the framework supports evaluation and judge/reward-model research rather than a verified ground-truth reward.

YESciEval 将科学回答判断拆为 9 个明确的 rubric 分数与理由，再以正常样本和对抗样本对 LLaMA-3.1-8B judge 进行 SFT 与对比偏好优化。其发布的语料覆盖 ORKGSyn 和 BioASQ 回答记录，包含 33 个学科及生物医学问答，并保留多种 LLM 的 1--5 分 rubric 评分。数据以 CSV 形式通过 YESciEval Corpus 发布，采用 CC BY 4.0；它服务于评测和 judge/reward model 研究，而非可验证的真值奖励。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Define the judgment contract. Each question, retrieved-paper context, and generated answer is rated from 1 to 5 on nine rubrics covering linguistic quality, logical structure, and content accuracy; the judge returns JSON scores and rationales.
  1. Build answer variants. Four open generators create benign answers for 348 ORKGSyn and 73 BioASQ summary questions. Rubric-specific heuristics then create subtle and extreme degradations; the known edit is the test oracle for a score decrease.
  1. Collect and align judges. Four models rotate as judges over every rubric and variant. LLaMA-3.1-8B is first QLoRA-SFTed on score/rationale records, then optimized with CPO preference pairs that prefer appropriate benign/adversarial discrimination.
  1. Evaluate robustness. Compare vanilla and aligned judges across the fixed variants. Reproduction requires the corpus version, nine rubric prompts, perturbation scripts, model checkpoints, ordering, and sampling settings; compute cost and some generation settings are not fully reported.

1. 定义判断契约。 每个问题、检索论文上下文和生成回答，均按语言质量、逻辑结构、内容准确性 3 类共 9 个 rubric 打 1--5 分；judge 输出 JSON 格式的分数和理由。
  1. 构造回答变体。 4 个开源生成器为 348 个 ORKGSyn 与 73 个 BioASQ 摘要问题生成正常回答。随后按 rubric 专门设计的规则生成轻度和重度降质版本；已知编辑应触发降分。
  1. 收集并对齐 judge。 4 个模型轮流评审每个 rubric 和变体。LLaMA-3.1-8B 先用 QLoRA 在分数/理由记录上 SFT，再以 CPO 偏好对优化，使其区分正常与对抗样本。
  1. 评估鲁棒性。 在固定变体上比较原始与对齐后的 judge。复现需固定语料版本、9 个 rubric prompt、扰动脚本、模型 checkpoint、顺序和采样设置；计算成本及部分生成设置未完整披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim. Alignment reduces optimism bias in an open science-Q&A judge. Setup. The paper evaluates four generators/judges on 348 ORKGSyn and 73 BioASQ questions, each with benign, subtle, and extreme variants across nine rubrics; this yields 37,584 ORKGSyn and 7,884 BioASQ scores. LLaMA-3.1-8B is compared before and after SFT+CPO.

Result and boundary. The adversarial construction makes intended degradation observable without using human labels for every score, and the paper reports more appropriate score separation after alignment. This supports robustness on these synthetic, rubric-targeted edits, not equivalence to expert scientific judgment or reliability under natural distribution shift.

主张。 对齐可降低开源科学问答 judge 的乐观偏差。设置。 论文让 4 个生成器/评审器处理 348 个 ORKGSyn 与 73 个 BioASQ 问题；每题均有正常、轻度和重度变体，并按 9 个 rubric 打分，得到 37,584 个 ORKGSyn 分数和 7,884 个 BioASQ 分数。比较对象为对齐前后的 LLaMA-3.1-8B。

结果与边界。 对抗构造使预期降质可被观察，无需为每个分数都提供人工标签；论文报告对齐后分数区分更恰当。这仅支持其对合成、rubric 定向编辑的鲁棒性，不能证明等同于科学专家判断或可迁移到自然分布变化。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier LLM-as-a-judge work often measures agreement on benign examples or relies on proprietary evaluators. YESciEval changes the evaluation object: each science answer is paired with a nine-rubric contract and controlled subtle/extreme failures, so a judge is tested for sensitivity to a specific defect. SFT and CPO are established techniques; the contribution is their combination with rubric-conditioned adversarial science-Q&A evaluation, not a new preference objective.
既有 LLM-as-a-judge 工作常在正常样本上测一致性，或依赖专有评审器。YESciEval 改变了评测对象：每个科学回答配有 9 项 rubric 契约及受控的轻度/重度失效，从而测试 judge 对特定缺陷的敏感性。SFT 与 CPO 都是既有技术；新意在于它们与 rubric 条件化的对抗科学问答评测结合，而不是提出新的偏好目标。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The paper assumes its heuristic edits reliably lower the targeted rubric quality. A judge can learn these perturbation signatures while still missing naturally occurring scientific errors; reuse should test untouched human- or expert-labelled failures.

The authors' manual observations find feedback can remain generic, overly optimistic, or inconsistent with its numeric score. Before using outputs as reward labels, audit score--rationale consistency and calibrate the rubric on the intended domain rather than treating a 1--5 score as truth.

论文假设其启发式编辑确会降低目标 rubric 的质量。judge 可能学到这些扰动特征，却仍识别不了自然出现的科学错误；复用时应在未改写的人类或专家标注失效案例上测试。

作者的人工观察发现，反馈仍可能空泛、过度乐观，或与数值评分不一致。在将输出用作奖励标签前，应审计分数与理由的一致性，并针对目标领域校准 rubric，不能把 1--5 分直接视为真值。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For a team evaluating retrieval-grounded science answers, reuse the nine-rubric prompt and the released CSV records to build a fixed judge audit set; report per-rubric score drops on benign and perturbed pairs. For training, use score/rationale records only after checking the CC BY 4.0 dataset terms and validating domain fit.

Do not copy its acceptance signal to tasks without paper-grounded Q&A context or without a way to audit natural errors. Success is a reproducible per-rubric discrimination result plus a sampled expert check, not a higher mean score alone.

若团队需要评测由检索支撑的科学回答，可复用 9 项 rubric prompt 和发布的 CSV 记录，构建固定的 judge 审计集，并报告正常/扰动回答在每项 rubric 上的降分。训练前须核对 CC BY 4.0 数据条款，并验证其与目标领域的匹配性。

不应将其接受信号直接搬到没有论文支撑的问答任务，或无法审计自然错误的任务。成功标准是可复现的逐 rubric 区分结果加抽样专家核验，而非仅提高平均分。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position. YESciEval tests whether an open judge notices defined failures in science Q&A rather than only whether it produces plausible scores.
  • Mechanism. Nine 1--5 rubrics, benign answers, and rubric-specific subtle/extreme edits create the comparison signal; CPO follows QLoRA SFT for LLaMA-3.1-8B.
  • Artifact. The YESciEval Corpus releases ORKGSyn and BioASQ CSVs, including 348 and 73 base questions, respectively, under CC BY 4.0.
  • Evidence anchor. Four models score 37,584 ORKGSyn and 7,884 BioASQ records; the claimed gain is limited to controlled perturbations.
  • Reuse decision. Use for paper-grounded scientific QA audits; first test score/rationale consistency and performance on natural expert-labelled failures.

• 定位。 YESciEval 测试开源 judge 能否发现科学问答中的既定失效，而不只测试其能否给出貌似合理的分数。
  • 方法抓手。 9 项 1--5 分 rubric、正常回答和 rubric 专属的轻度/重度编辑构成比较信号；LLaMA-3.1-8B 先经 QLoRA SFT，再用 CPO 对齐。
  • 数据抓手。 YESciEval Corpus 发布 ORKGSyn 和 BioASQ 的 CSV，基础问题分别为 348 和 73 个，采用 CC BY 4.0。
  • 证据锚点。 4 个模型对 37,584 条 ORKGSyn 和 7,884 条 BioASQ 记录评分；收益仅覆盖受控扰动。
  • 复用决定。 适合论文支撑的科学问答审计；先检查分数/理由一致性及其在自然专家标注失效上的表现。
